peek_angles.name: Shoulder peek from left wall
peek_angles.description: Use the left wall for a shoulder peek into A Main to bait util and gather info.

peek_angles.name: Hold A Main from generator
peek_angles.description: Pre-aim generator head-level and hold an off-angle near CT as defender.

Sova.name: A Site recon bolt (A Main entry)
Sova.description: Back-left corner of A Main, aim above the tree line, 2 bounces, full charge. Reveals site default.

Sova.name: CT spawn shock dart
Sova.description: Standard post-plant dart landing on default plant spot.

Viper.name: A Main entry wall
Viper.description: Line up against the left wall and throw toxic screen straight through A Main to cut site.

Omen.name: A Site double smoke from A Main
Omen.description: From A Main corner: one smoke on CT, one on Generator. Blocks both defender angles.

KAY/O.name: ZERO/point knife into A Site
KAY/O.description: From back of A Main, aim at A Site roof for a suppress that lands on default plant.

tips: Don't wide-peek — shoulder peek to bait sentinel util.
Listen for A Tree footsteps before committing.
Drop smokes before util like Sova arrows.

peek_angles.name: CT doorway hold
peek_angles.description: Crosshair on CT doorway head-level while anchoring.

peek_angles.name: Heaven off-angle
peek_angles.description: Hold from Heaven with a pixel-peek over the railing.

Sova.name: Post-plant dart to default
Sova.description: From CT corner, align with minimap edge and throw for default plant clear.

Brimstone.name: A Site retake smoke stack
Brimstone.description: Drop smokes on Heaven, CT, and Generator to isolate the site for retake.

Cypher.name: A Site anchor trip + cam
Cypher.description: Tripwire across A Main choke, camera on generator covering site and default plant.

Killjoy.name: A Site full lockdown
Killjoy.description: Turret on boxes watching A Main, alarm bot behind generator, nanoswarms on default plant.

Chamber.name: A Site tp retreat
Chamber.description: Trademark covering A Main; Rendezvous anchored at CT for instant rotate/retreat.

Sage.name: A Site wall delay
Sage.description: Save wall for A Main push — wall off the entry to delay and let teammates rotate.

tips: Anchor from CT or Heaven — avoid getting traded in open site.
Pre-plant util before dropping onto site as attacker.
Communicate plant position for your post-plant lineups.

peek_angles.name: Mid Top angle from Market
peek_angles.description: Peek Mid Top from Market with a tight head-level crosshair.

peek_angles.name: Catwalk hold
peek_angles.description: Hold Catwalk from the back with an AWP-friendly long angle.

Sova.name: Catwalk recon from Mid Top
Sova.description: From Mid Top, aim at the pillar near Catwalk. 1 bounce, full charge.

Viper.name: Mid control wall
Viper.description: Wall from Market through Mid Top to cut Catwalk vision and take Mid control.

Killjoy.name: Mid Market alarm
Killjoy.description: Alarm bot tucked in Market corner — catches mid-takes early.

tips: Mid control = map control on Ascent. Don't neglect it.
Smoke Catwalk + Top Mid to take a safe Market push.

peek_angles.name: B Main shoulder peek
peek_angles.description: Shoulder peek from Market side to bait sentinel util.

Sova.name: B Site recon bolt
Sova.description: From B Main back, aim above doorway, 1 bounce, full charge.

Omen.name: B Site double smoke
Omen.description: Smoke CT and Lane from B Main to safely plant default.

Killjoy.name: B Site full lockdown
Killjoy.description: Turret on stairs, alarm bot in CT, nanoswarms on default plant.

Cypher.name: B Boathouse flank watch
Cypher.description: Trip across Boathouse to catch mid→B flanks. Cam on CT covering site.

tips: Check Boathouse before pushing B Main.
B plant is vulnerable to Market flanks — clear Market first.

peek_angles.name: CT corner hold
peek_angles.description: Anchor from CT corner, crosshair on B Main entry.

Sova.name: B post-plant shock
Sova.description: From back of B, align with default plant and throw arced shock.

Killjoy.name: B ultimate retake
Killjoy.description: Lockdown ultimate from CT covers full site for a forced retake.

tips: Default plant is the safest for post-plant lineups.
